{{Top|leg}}
'''Irstat-Kes''' was a title that was held by the tribal leaders of the [[Tarasin]], a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. Each Tarasin [[irstat]], the tribal groups in which they lived, had an Irstat-Kes, who was normally the second eldest [[Gender/Legends|female]] in the irstat. Irstat-Kes meant "tribal leader" and most Irtstat-Kes' were [[Force Adept]]s, although this was not required.<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

The Tarasin [[Cryalira]] was the Irstat-Kes of the [[Hiironi irstat]],<ref name="LFCG" /> while [[Mir'Liss]] was the Irstat-Kes of the [[Jaraana irstat]].<ref name="Force Concession">{{LivingForce|Forces of Cularin: Force Concession}}</ref>
